sentences.en: We exchanged phone numbers at the end of the gathering.
sentences.zh: 我们在聚会结束时交换了电话号码。

sentences.en: The gathering will be large if the weather is good.
sentences.zh: 如果天气好的话，聚会有可能会有很多人参加。

sentences.en: Will you take care of gathering materials for the climb?
sentences.zh: 你会负责收集登山所需的物资吗？
